description: This pie chart illustrates four conceptual dimensions of a reasoning benchmark, divided into four equal slices that each represent approximately 25% of the total area. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit numerical percentage labels; instead, each slice contains internal text labels accompanied by a black line-art icon, and is associated with an external text box outlined in a matching color. The top-left slice is yellow, labeled "Complexity" with a ladder icon, and links to an external box reading "Uncrushable". The top-right slice is light blue, labeled "Instance" with a shield and checkmark icon, linking to an external box partially visible as "Unhack...". The bottom-right slice is light green, labeled "Coverage" with a gear and globe icon, linking to a box reading "General". The bottom-left slice is red, labeled "Scalable Oversight" with a clipboard and checkmark icon, linking to a box partially visible as "Auto-...ble". Visually, the chart is rendered with a tilted perspective, and all four segments are slightly exploded, separated from one another by white space. Because all slices are equal in size, there is no descending or ascending order to their arrangement.
